Ceramic artist and mindful lifestyle creator in South Mumbai. Big fan of pottery wheels, Marine Drive sunsets, and meaningful heart-to-hearts 🏺🌊
Equity research analyst who balances balance sheets with weekend hiking trips to Rajmachi. I make great pasta from scratch and play mean Catan!
Interior space stylist, road trip navigator, and proud golden retriever owner. Sukhna lake sunset walks and cold coffee are non-negotiable weekends 🐾
Tech lead building open source developer tools. When not coding, you will find me climbing forts in the Western Ghats or making pour-over Aeropress coffee ⛰️☕

Organic farm manager & artisanal sourdough baker in Gangapur. Weekend cyclist, dog rescue volunteer, and lover of slow Sunday breakfasts in the orchard 🥖🐕

Investment partner focused on climate technology. Early morning squash player, espresso purist, and lover of jazz bars in Colaba 🎾☕
3D game animator crafting fantasy RPG worlds. Big anime fan, synthesizers collector, and always hunting down late-night burger joints in KP 🎮🍔
AI researcher working on multimodal vision models. Weekend boulderer at Equilibrium, pour-over coffee geek, and vinyl record collector 🧗‍♂️🎧
Chef and sourdough bistro owner. I will cook you the crispiest artisanal pizzas and tell you stories behind every spice. Upendra road food walks fan 🍕👨‍🍳
Indie acoustic guitarist and singer-songwriter. You will either find me recording chords in my home studio or playing open mics at Viman Nagar 🎸✨
Wildlife biologist & nature photographer tracking tiger corridors in Tadoba and Pench. Let's watch stars around a campfire and share jungle tales 🐅⛺
Creative ad copywriter and weekend stand-up comedian. If you appreciate puns, dry humor, and deep conversations over cutting chai, swipe right! ☕🎙️
Tech policy lawyer by day, amateur jazz pianist by night. Khan Market book shopper, lover of winter sunshine, and passionate about art galleries 🎹📖
Sports physiotherapist and calisthenics trainer in Aundh. Passionate about holistic mobility, outdoor trail runs, and making healthy meals that actually taste great 🥗🏃‍♂️
Renewable energy design engineer working on solar microgrids. Astrophotography nerd who loves driving into the hills on moonless nights to shoot constellations 🔭✨
Architectural furniture craftsman creating minimalist wooden tables. Cat dad to a tuxedo cat named Oreo, filter coffee lover, and weekend thrift hunter 🪵☕🐈
